preamble: The voiceless retroflex (apical postalveolar) affricate [ʈʂ] loses its retroflex (apical, tongue-curled) articulation and is realized as a laminal palato-alveolar affricate [tʃ]. In Croatian and Bosnian this goes together with a merger of the č–ć contrast into a single [tʃ]; in Taiwan Mandarin the retroflex initials of Standard Mandarin may be realized as postalveolars rather than merging fully with the dentals. The shift is phonetic and regional rather than a widespread historical change.

examples.note: In most spoken Croatian and some Bosnian varieties the retroflex affricates č, dž are postalveolar, and many speakers merge č /ʈʂ/ and ć /tɕ/ into a single [tʃ] (Ćavar 2011).
The same postalveolar realization of č applies across the lexicon in most spoken Croatian.
Besides full merger with z [ts], Taiwan Guoyu speakers may realize the retroflex initials zh, ch, sh as postalveolar consonants (Chung 2006).
The whole retroflex series is realized as postalveolar in this Taiwan Guoyu pattern.
